about.title: About
about.p1: This is an open source project for learning to read and understand code, from beginner to advanced. AI writes code faster than people do, so the bottleneck is now understanding and reviewing it.
about.p2: Courses are short code blocks followed by multiple-choice questions. Every wrong answer maps to a named misconception and comes with its own explanation.
about.limits.title: Honest limits
about.limits.1: This is an early draft. There are few questions, and they are still being reviewed.
about.limits.2: Progress is saved only in this browser. There are no accounts yet.
about.limits.3: A question's code is checked by running it, but whether a question teaches well is a human judgement, and we can be wrong.
about.privacy.title: Privacy
about.privacy.text: This site uses no cookies, analytics, tracking or external fonts. Your answers, your colour theme choice and one small setting (whether you have seen the first step-through introduction) stay in your browser's local storage and are not sent anywhere. The site is delivered through a hosting provider and a content delivery network, which process ordinary web requests (such as your IP address) to serve the pages.
about.license.title: Licenses
about.license.text: The platform is AGPL-3.0, the question schema and validator are MIT, and questions are CC BY-SA 4.0.
